activity_statements.statement: designs, manufactures, and supplies complete vehicle seating systems (seat assemblies, covers, foam) to major global automotive manufacturers as the largest US-based automotive supplier
designs and manufactures electrical distribution systems, wiring harnesses, and connection systems for vehicles (E-Systems segment)
develops battery management systems and power electronics for electric and hybrid vehicle platforms in its E-Systems segment
supplies seating and electrical systems to the world's leading automotive OEMs, winning 2026 Ford Supplier of the Year (Sustainability) and 2025 GM Supplier of the Year (both Seating and E-Systems)
operates global manufacturing facilities across multiple continents in a just-in-time supply model for automotive production lines

name_reality_gap: Index label 'Motor Vehicle Manufacturing' implies Lear makes vehicles; it is a tier-1 automotive supplier making components (seats and electrical/electronic systems) — never complete vehicles. The E-Systems segment makes it a significant participant in EV electrification infrastructure, invisible from the index label.
extraction_notes: lear.com/about-lear/ returned 404; homepage provided clear segment and product information. Seating/E-Systems revenue split based on publicly known Lear segment structure (approx 60/40); not extracted from source directly.
